conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.summary: Common combat conditions and their mechanical effects.

blinded.title: Blinded
blinded.body: Cannot see and automatically fails checks that require sight.

charmed.title: Charmed
charmed.body: Cannot attack the charmer and the charmer has advantage on social checks.

deafened.title: Deafened
deafened.body: Cannot hear and automatically fails checks that require hearing.

frightened.title: Frightened
frightened.body: Has disadvantage while the source of fear is in sight and cannot willingly move closer.

grappled.title: Grappled
grappled.body: Speed becomes 0 until the grapple ends.

invisible.title: Invisible
invisible.body: Cannot be seen without special senses or magic.

paralyzed.title: Paralyzed
paralyzed.body: Is incapacitated, cannot move or speak, and is especially vulnerable to attacks.

actions-in-combat.title: Actions in Combat
actions-in-combat.summary: Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, and Use an Object.

0.title: Common actions
0.body: On your turn you can take one action. Common actions include Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, and Use an Object.

resting.title: Resting
resting.summary: Short and long rest rules for recovery during play.

0.title: Short rest
0.body: A short rest is a period of downtime, at least 1 hour long, during which characters do nothing more strenuous than eating, drinking, reading, and tending wounds.

1.title: Long rest
1.body: A long rest is an extended downtime period used to recover hit points, features, and spell slots according to class rules.

ability-checks.title: Ability Checks
ability-checks.summary: Ability checks resolve uncertain actions using d20 plus the relevant ability modifier and proficiency when applicable.

0.title: Core check
0.body: Roll a d20 and add the relevant ability modifier. If a character has proficiency that applies, add the proficiency bonus.

saving-throws.title: Saving Throws
saving-throws.summary: Saving throws resist harmful effects and use d20 plus an ability modifier and proficiency when applicable.

0.title: Core save
0.body: A saving throw represents an attempt to resist a spell, trap, poison, disease, or similar threat.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.summary: Weapons, armor, adventuring gear, tools, packs, and spellcasting focuses from the equipment catalog.

spellcasting-basics.title: Spellcasting Basics
spellcasting-basics.summary: Spell level, casting time, range, components, duration, concentration, rituals, and higher-level casting.

0.title: Spell anatomy
0.body: A spell entry includes level, school, casting time, range, components, duration, and spell text. Some spells have ritual, concentration, or higher-level casting rules.
